summary: Implemented the frontend core and TIR for the elementwise path. a100c/ir/tir.py defines tir/v1 (Type width+signedness, distinct convert/bitcast ops, masked ops with a DECLARED masked_default (value/undef/no-access), per-axis extents with a broadcast flag distinct from real extents, i32/i64 index arithmetic, structured If/Loop regions with explicit joins) plus a structural verifier rejecting one hand-built malformed module per invariant class and accepting the real frontend output. a100c/ir/dump.py dumps TIR with per-op source attribution. a100c/frontend/: source.py loads operator modules by AST (single @triton.jit invariant, autotune configs, do_not_specialize lists, constexpr defaults incl. module-level constexpr globals, case-layer literals; located refusals for two jit kernels, torch, execution-path imports, non-literal case tables); surface.py embeds the recorded 107-construct/280-parameter api_spec as data with every parameter classified implemented / ignorable-with-reason / refused, and the lowering consults that classification (the control: marking tl.load.other or tl.store.mask ignorable visibly breaks masked semantics); specialize.py builds the meta-tier specialization identity (source path + kernel name + pointer device dtypes with pointer_dtypes overrides + scalar classes honoring do_not_specialize/do_not_specialize_on_alignment + all meta/launch_meta constexprs + the deterministic first autotune config) and the ConstexprEnv that folds tl.constexpr conditions, dtype predicates (ptr.type/tensor .dtype.element_ty, is_floating/is_int_signed/is_int_unsigned/int_bitwidth, tl.constexpr(x) wrappers, trace-time builtins) and dead dispatch branches while recording every folded comparison; types.py encodes the pinned Triton 3.8 rules (literal typing, integer promotion with i1 as a signed 1-bit integer, the scalar-participation computation_type matrix incl. the fp16/bf16 div/mod exception, convert vs bitcast legality); shapes.py does right-aligned rank/extent unification with broadcast-flag propagation (disagreement is a located diagnostic); lower_tir.py lowers the elementwise core (masked load with other / store, arithmetic incl. ptr+element-offset, comparisons, bitwise/logical, where, constants, program_id, tl.arange/tl.zeros/tl.full/tl.zeros_like) inserting the pinned implicit casts and broadcasts as explicit convert/broadcast ops and realizing broadcast extents before memory ops. Verified: all five declared tests pass (58 checks, exit 0); the full-corpus census (2734 cases) shows the identity model is exactly the corpus meta tier coarsened only by the mandated do_not_specialize exclusion (2113 identities vs the live identity.py 2116; the 3 merged groups are var_mean_welford_kernel's do_not_specialize=['correction','M','N'], which the pinned Triton 3.8 specialize.cc also drops from the key; the corpus's declared 2161 in SUITE_V3.md 10.2 is doc drift, recorded); 31 of 500 operators lower end-to-end to verified TIR over all their cases today and 469 refuse with located diagnostics naming the construct (tl.cast 189, for 80, subscript 47, tl.cdiv 36, tl.num_programs 18, tl.sum 17, ...) -- exactly the constructs owned by T008-T016, the designed refusal boundary, never a silent miscompile.
